failure_phase: Stage A complete dataset regeneration after all source tests passed
source_tests: 10/10 passed on Python 3.10, 3.11, and 3.12 before generator failure
root_cause: The preregistered generator implementation used a deterministic signature bucket for compositional isolation. The selected signature==0 bucket contained no valid Protocol-v2 ACT formal state, so an action-balanced compositional holdout could not be generated. No natural-language holdout example or evaluation metric was inspected.
repair_scope: Replace only the infeasible compositional partition implementation with a generator-known held-out conjunction: clarification_possible=true AND acknowledged=true AND deferral_available=true.
Train and validation exclude that conjunction; compositional_holdout includes it. Individual semantic primitives remain available outside the held-out conjunction.
Add a formal-state-only unit test using the frozen Protocol-v2 oracle to assert that the compositional partition contains at least one valid state for each of the six actions.
